name: Amicus Birthday Project
source:
Five years after Adastra took place, the Parents tell Marco that he has to go back to Adastra, and, coincidentally, this just happens on Amicus' birthday!

[From [url=https://jogab.itch.io/amicusbirthdayproject]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿达斯特拉发生五年后，父母告诉马可他必须回到阿达斯特拉，巧合的是，这恰好发生在阿米库斯的生日那天！

[来自[url=https://jogab.itch.io/amicusbirthdayproject]Itch.io[/url]]
